Name: mod jam 2023 music mod updated for 1.6
Author: mycatoreo
Description:
Iron chef was the theme of mod jam 2023 the themes were:
• Slippery
• Boom
• Voyage
• Rotten
• Constellation

You had to use 3 out of the 5 themes 
the thems i chose were:
Slippery:  being Slippery climb from crash bandicoot 1 replacing the frost ambient music 
Rotten: being have a rotten day and keeper of hades from monster hunter world  replacing the volcano mines music
Constellation : being Star by Toby Fox from undertales replacing maru's music theme

Manifest.Description: replaces some music in the game. slippery climb is from crash bandicoot and is replacing the frost ambient. both have a rotten day and keeper of hades are from monster hunter world and replacing the volcano mines music. toby fox star is from undertales and is replacing maru's 6 heart event music
